First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @skiandbikeshop_gf the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Ski & Bike Shop Wednesday Mountain Bike Ride group ride

Ski & Bike Shop Wednesday Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Grand Forks, ND. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Lincoln Park.

The shop’s mountain bike group ride, open to all skill levels, on the trails around Lincoln Park. The shop also runs a no-drop gravel ride on Mondays and a no-drop road ride on Thursdays.
